Priya: Heads up 5m55 SRE flagged a routing rollback tonight, marketing needs statuspage + targeted email wording and timing.
Marco: When's the window?
Sam: Rollback scheduled 19:30-19:50 PT. Low risk, no DB changes.
Nora: Ok. We should prep: 1) short public statuspost, 2) segmented email to dedicated/enterprise customers, 3) internal support copy.
Priya: Draft status post: "We detected intermittent increased inference latency after a recent routing rollout. We initiated a rollback at 19:30 PT to restore normal service. No customer data was impacted. Next update by 20:00 PT." Thoughts?
Marco: Good. Replace "increased inference latency" with "higher-than-normal inference latency and occasional 5xx errors" to be explicit. Add one line for Dedicated: "Dedicated customers may have experienced intermittent errors."
Sam: +1. Keep ETA for next update.
Ravi: For the targeted email subject: "Redwood Inference: Routing rollback and potential impact to your Dedicated capacity" Body: 3 bullets (what happened, what we did, action required: none). Include incident ID INC-2026-051 and support link.
Nora: Also prepare canned Intercom snippets and a Slack support channel post for Support ops. Keep canned replies <2 sentences.
Priya: We'll queue the statuspost to publish at rollback start. Need signoff by 19:15 PT. I'll drop the copy here in 10m.
devops-bot: Incident created 5INC-2026-0515 Severity: degraded. Owner: Sam.
Marco: If rollback doesn't stabilize by 19:45 escalate to oncall.
Sam: Roger. I'll update this thread at 19:35 with progress.
Priya: Thanks team, prepping drafts now. :white_check_mark:
